purpose: Adapters for strict nineteenth-century Utrecht and Vienna collection-story/archive nodes. The existing Powerhouse adapter is reused.
guards: Treat published/distributed set counts, surviving set counts, and later museum custody as separate layers.
For person-attributed preparations, preserve the institution's attribution language and do not invent exact preparation dates or quantities.
Follow archive/correspondence links as provenance evidence but do not convert archival letter counts into object counts.

adapters.target: official collection stories for surviving nineteenth-century microscopic preparations
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture named maker/researcher, set structure, publication/distribution dates, correspondence/archive hooks and current museum custody. For Cinchona preserve 125+25 surviving sets separately from six originally distributed pairs.

adapters.institution_scope: Naturhistorisches Museum Wien Archive for History of Science
adapters.target: official archive pages describing historical material-object collections
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture creator attribution and archive custody; leave count null unless a slide-level or container inventory is recovered.
